Hi all,

Quick summary / answers we can provide immediately: 

1) No-training attestation: Redwood does not use customer prompts or generated responses to train or improve our base models by default. Training on customer data only occurs under an explicit, documented opt-in program (we include customers in a separate fine-tune/onboarding process with contractual terms). Attached: redwood_no_train_attestation.pdf (signed internal template).

2) Audit artifacts: attached SOC2-summary-2027.pdf and SIG-responses-2027-07.pdf (redacted where necessary).

3) Retention policy (defaults):
- Interaction prompts & responses: 30 days by default for hosted API accounts; queued KV cache and transient artifacts are ephemeral and expire sooner.
- API request/trace logs (diagnostics): retained 90 days; metrics-level telemetry stored longer in aggregated form.
- We offer configurable longer retention or shorter retention for Dedicated/Private customers via contract.

4) Deletion / opt-out: customers can request deletion through the Console or by opening a support ticket. For hosted accounts we run a deletion workflow that removes prompts/responses and associated indices within 5 business days (exceptions: cached backups are purged within 30 days). For Dedicated/Private we provide on-prem tooling or assisted deletion.

5) Export for FT-1184: we can produce a one-time export for the requested timeframe. We will deliver a CSV manifest (example attached: ft-export-manifest-june-2027.csv) and the export bundle as a password-protected archive. Please confirm: (a) exact account id (FT-1184 is correct?), (b) preferred delivery method (SFTP or secure Drive), and (c) whether FinTrust requires redaction of PII prior to export.

6) Instructions and security controls: see session_export_instructions.md for how we extract and the fields included in the manifest.

Timeline: We can produce the export and deliver signed attestation within 3 business days after you confirm delivery method and redaction preferences.

Attachments: redwood_no_train_attestation.pdf; SOC2-summary-2027.pdf; SIG-responses-2027-07.pdf; session_export_instructions.md; ft-export-manifest-june-2027.csv

I'll start the export job once Evelyn confirms the account id and delivery channel.

Hi Elena — quick answers and next steps from legal/ops: 

- Logs and PII: Redwood's API accepts and logs whatever the customer sends; we do not automatically redact customer-provided content. Customers are responsible for client-side redaction if they do not want certain PII persisted. That said, our production logging pipeline flags high-risk tokens for manual review and we offer guidance on in-line redaction and client-side hashing.

- Delivery: SFTP works. We will stage a password-protected archive on a secure SFTP host and share credentials through the secure channel.

- Attestation: we've prepared a short attestation and will send via DocuSign. Link: https://www.docusign.com/FT-1184-attestation (this will be the envelope for signature).

Next steps: please confirm (1) whether you want Redwood to run a PII-redaction pass prior to export (we can do this with configurable rules) and (2) the SFTP hostname and preferred delivery window (we can schedule for 14–16 Jul). Once you confirm, Marissa will kick off the export job.

Regards,
